agents.name: architect
agents.description: Designs system architecture, evaluates trade-offs, and creates incremental technical plans. Use for new systems, major refactors, service boundaries, and architecture decisions.

agents.name: backend-engineer
agents.description: Implements and reviews backend services, APIs, integrations, and background processing. Use for Python/FastAPI/Django services, business logic, persistence boundaries, and backend reliability.

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.description: Performs independent, evidence-based code reviews for correctness, security, compatibility, and reliability. Use on diffs and pull requests; should report findings rather than edit code.

agents.name: database-engineer
agents.description: Designs and optimizes relational schemas, queries, indexes, transactions, and migrations. Use for PostgreSQL/SQL work, data integrity, performance, and safe schema evolution.

agents.name: devops-engineer
agents.description: Builds secure, reproducible CI/CD and cloud deployment systems. Use for Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure configuration, release engineering, and observability.

agents.name: frontend-engineer
agents.description: Builds accessible, responsive frontend experiences and TypeScript applications. Use for UI features, component architecture, forms, state, routing, and browser behavior.

agents.name: security-auditor
agents.description: Audits code, APIs, dependencies, and deployment configuration for security risks. Use before releases and when reviewing auth, data handling, trust boundaries, or infrastructure.

agents.name: test-engineer
agents.description: Designs and implements deterministic automated tests across unit, integration, contract, UI, and end-to-end layers. Use for feature validation, regression coverage, and CI reliability.

agents.name: documentation-engineer
agents.description: Creates accurate technical documentation, runbooks, ADRs, API guides, onboarding material, and release notes. Use when documenting software behavior or operational procedures.

agents.name: bug-investigator
agents.description: Finds root causes of complex or intermittent bugs through reproducible experiments and evidence. Use when a symptom crosses components or the cause is unclear.
